source.description:
## PROBLEM

The archive shape lives in mercury/infra (epic infra-223r, local bead infra-223r.5): every terminal sre-triage chain run must write a durable per-run bundle into the target repo at `services/sre-triage-runs/<UTC>_<chain_id_short>/`. Nothing in this chain runtime emits bundles today — the archive stays empty except for the seeded example in mercury/infra (.3). The WRITER must live here (experiments/agentsession-sre-chain-vertical-slice/src/chain), not in mercury/infra.

## SUCCESS

A small pure function (in a new src/chain/finalize.ts, or in scheduler.ts) called from the terminal-state handler emits a bundle for BOTH terminal states (satisfied AND escalated) at exactly:

    <target-repo>/.xtrm/skills/infra/service-knowledge/services/sre-triage-runs/<UTC>_<chain_id_short>/

with the deterministic file list:

- chain-report.v1.json (schema key 'schema': 'chain-report.v1' at top level; includes next_actions[] array)
- report.md (coordinator hand-written narrative: incident brief, findings, gotchas, fixes, workarounds, deferred, next-actions — written by the coordinator as its coordinator.decision evidence body, materialized by this writer)
- gotchas.jsonl (one JSON object per line: {"kind":..., "resource":..., "symptom":..., "evidence_ref":..., "fix_applied":..., "worked":true|false, "prior_run_refs":[]})
- evidence/*.json (the run's evidence entries from evidence/index.jsonl, expanded one file each)
- forensics.jsonl (copy of forensics/events.jsonl)
- messages.jsonl (copy of channels/messages.jsonl)

Plus ONE structured event in the run's forensics/events.jsonl:

    sre-triage.bundle.written  fields: {chain_id, chain_run_id, bundle_path, terminal_state, files_written[], bytes_written, elapsed_ms}

## SCOPE

- src/chain/finalize.ts (new) or scheduler.ts — the terminal-state handler hook.
- Reuse src/chain/store.ts paths() for the run's evidence/forensics/messages sources.

## NON_GOALS

- No new package. Writer is a small pure function.
- Failure to write the bundle is a fact.warning (NOT fatal) — a write failure must not sink an otherwise-successful chain.
- Do NOT change the bundle shape declared in mercury/infra .3/.4 — this repo materializes it.
- No changes to mercury/infra from this issue.

## CONSTRAINTS

- Writer: small pure function in finalize.ts (or scheduler.ts) called from the terminal-state handler; no new package.
- Bundle path template: services/sre-triage-runs/<UTC>_<chain_id_short>/ (UTC ISO compact, e.g. 20260819T015344Z).
- Redaction: no raw secrets, no full env dumps, no PII in report.md or gotchas.jsonl.
- The sre-triage.bundle.written event fields: {chain_id, chain_run_id, bundle_path, terminal_state, files_written, bytes_written, elapsed_ms}.
- Sequencing: this issue references the two existing findings filed earlier — xtrm-pq1.1 (coordinator contract adherence: coordinator must call evidence_publish(kind=coordinator.decision)) and xtrm-pq1.2 (bridge/custom-provider resolution: model not found for commandcode/deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash). The bundle writer depends on both landing: pq1.1 fixes coordinator-entry satisfaction (so a run reaches terminal state), pq1.2 fixes specialist dispatch on custom providers.

## VALIDATION

- [ ] One live chain run emits a bundle at the exact path template with all six required files.
- [ ] Bundle passes the shape check from mercury/infra infra-223r.3 (chain-report.v1.json schema key, gotchas.jsonl line shape, report.md headings).
- [ ] sre-triage.bundle.written event present in that run's forensics/events.jsonl (grep passes).
- [ ] Both terminal states covered: satisfied run AND escalated run each emit.
- [ ] Write failure does not crash the chain (fact.warning only).

## OUTPUT

- Path of the first live-emitted bundle under services/sre-triage-runs/.
- One grep line from that run's forensics showing sre-triage.bundle.written.
- Confirmation of both terminal states covered.

## LIBRARIES

N/A — small pure TS function in the existing experiment package.

## NOTES

Filed from mercury/infra epic infra-223r (local tracking bead infra-223r.5). The mercury/infra side owns the SHAPE (docs in services/sre-triage-runs/SKILL.md + INDEXING-DECISION.md); this issue owns the WRITER. Cross-repo sequencing: do NOT merge before xtrm-pq1.1 + xtrm-pq1.2 are addressed (they fix coordinator-entry satisfaction + custom-provider dispatch that a real chain needs to reach terminal state).
